PMF.iid: The n-fold iid law of p on a finite alphabet is the law of a length-n word with independent coordinates of common law p. The mass of x is ∏ᵢ p(xᵢ).
PMF.finiteProduct_map_append_symm: Split a product word of length m+n after its first m coordinates. The two blocks are independent, with the prescribed coordinate laws restricted to their respective positions.
PMF.channelJoint_finiteProduct_map_appen: Concatenating two independent product words of lengths m and n gives the product law with the first m marginal laws taken from p and the last n from q.
PMF.iid_map_perm: The law of n independent draws from p is unchanged by any permutation of the n coordinates.
